extracted.stage: Financial provision action proceeding to proof
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for the pursuer in a financial provision action at Edinburgh Sheriff Court asks whether funding of £18,500 is available against matrimonial property of around £185,000 in Scotland.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the details of your client's financial provision action. So that we can consider it properly, we would be grateful for confirmation of the jurisdiction and court handling the matter, the date of the next hearing or proof, and a breakdown of the costs the £18,500 is intended to cover. It would also help to have further information on the matrimonial property, including its composition and any existing charges or competing claims. We will review the matter once that information is to hand and come back to you. Please note this acknowledgement does not constitute an offer of funding or any indication of terms.
